main_claim: LLM-directed joint kernel and mean selection with numerical feedback, followed by covariance-preserving conditional simulation
site: Leendert de Boerspolder, crest line 7, 29 CPTs

response.choice: fixed before candidate ranking, based on positive right-skewed resistance

test_role: fixed whole-CPT interpolation evaluation; no outcome enters model search or data summary

fitting.main_initialization: neutral starts plus feasible same-kernel fitted parent means

search.primary_application_model: lowest training AIC accessed in the first Astra repetition
search.secondary_application_model: lowest training AIC accessed in the first Fable repetition
search.selection_rule: representative repetitions fixed before API outputs and test metrics; all six repetitions reported

search_references: uniform random 20 distinct accesses, exact finite-library probabilities
prediction_models: best SE mean by training AIC
best RQ mean by training AIC
best 16-model Matern-family reference by training AIC
best full-library model by training AIC

primary: RMSE in MPa using predictive observation mean
NLPD in MPa including lognormal Jacobian

density.meaning: fixed kernel and mean forms selected using main 12-CPT training set; refit continuous parameters for each count, no repeated LLM selection

resolution.meaning: fixed-structure sensitivity to vertical sampling, same physical window

random_fields.area_definition: fraction of cross-sectional area with latent qc below threshold, trapezoidal spatial weights
random_fields.interpretation: low-resistance extent descriptor; not a failure probability or a universal soil-strength boundary

matched_timing.run_conditions: same machine, serial after main fit workers finish
